content.content: The exclude interface reads the file whole: the read yields `.git/info/exclude`'s contents as they stand, so every line already recorded is visible to the write.
content.rationale: S2-exclude fixes the file and that it is both read and written; the whole-file read is the separate commitment that makes the write an append rather than a replacement. A read that yielded only git's template, or none of the file, would force the write to reconstruct what is there — the clobber the parent rejects. Reading whole leaves the existing lines for the write to preserve.
